auth.intro: Use your Brain Trails account of this environment. The console then asks for the code from your authenticator app.
auth.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app.
auth.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the code for Brain Trails console.
auth.enrollIntro: Scan the code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the six digits it shows. This is asked once; the secret is not shown again.
auth.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app

errors.product_login_refused: That email and password do not open an account here.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not open an account here.
errors.not_a_console_user: This account has no access to the console. Ask Alessio for it.
errors.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the clock of your phone and try again.
errors.signed_out: Your console session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your console level does not allow this.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.product_unavailable: The product did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.upstream_unavailable: The console's service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.console_unavailable: This console is not configured yet.
errors.read_unavailable: This console has no read connection to the product database yet.
errors.already_enrolled: This account already has its second factor. Sign in again to enter a code.

worklog.intro: What Alessio and Claude did together, session by session, with the tokens it took. Filters narrow the totals, the list and the report alike.
worklog.emptyText: Nothing matches these filters, or nothing was imported yet.
worklog.tokensNote: New tokens are the work added at each turn: input, cache writes and output. Tokens read from cache are the context read back at every turn, and cost much less. Both come from the Claude Code session transcripts, subagents included.

totals.title: Tokens
totals.hoursHint: Every thread counts in full, also in parallel; offline time included

widgets.workWeek: {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}: {done} done, {open} in progress, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
widgets.tokensWeekChart: New tokens per day this week

hours.title: Time spent
hours.note: A day's total adds the time of every thread in full, also when threads ran in parallel, and the time worked away from any session.
hours.none: No time recorded in this selection.

overview.intro: The numbers of the product's admin dashboard, read from the product database through the console's read-only connection when you refresh a panel.
